about:
Carolina Wood Products operates from Marshville, North Carolina, where it has manufactured wood pallets and packaging since 1969. The company was founded by Robert and Frances Horne in nearby Peachland before moving to its current Marshville facility. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the business is led by Ronald and Randy Horne, with the next generation, Matt and Randall Horne, recently completing a major sawmill expansion.

The company produces new pallets to GMA standard and custom dimensions, heat-treated pallets certified to ISPM-15 for export, repaired and reconditioned pallets in Grade A and Grade B, as well as custom wooden crates and boxes built to exact specifications. Production relies on automated nailing machines and computerized saws, and a $2.5 million sawmill expansion completed recently added capacity for lumber processing and wood byproducts such as boiler fuel and wood chips. The Marshville facility serves customers across North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia.

Customers span manufacturing, food and agriculture, building materials and lumber, distribution and warehousing, export and international shipping, and biomass energy sectors. The company supplies pallets and packaging to businesses in Charlotte, Raleigh, Greensboro, Winston-Salem, Fayetteville, Durham, and throughout the Piedmont and coastal regions.

Carolina Wood Products emphasizes that it is a local manufacturer, not a broker, with every pallet built on-site in Marshville. This vertical integration allows consistent quality, faster turnaround, and direct communication with the production team. The family ownership and recent capital investment reflect a long-term commitment to the region’s supply chain.
